subject: Pricing exhibit: rate shelter / margin carve-out questions
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@acerohealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acerohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing exhibit questions — shelter/margin carve-out

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement ran the draft pricing exhibit against our RFP constraints overnight and flagged two areas where we need clarification before legal will accept:

1) "Rate shelter" language in Section 2 — the draft appears to allow Redwood to apply a discretionary margin above the committed rate when utilization drops below the minimum band. We need a clear ceiling on any such adjustments and an explicit carve-out limited to documented cost increases (e.g., new regulatory charges).

2) Margin carve-out for partner pass-throughs — the exhibit implies pass-throughs may be excluded from the floor calculation. Can you confirm whether partner costs will be treated as part of committed usage or billed separately?

We attached an excerpt from our RFP (Acero_RFP_excerpt.docx) for context. Can we get a redline that clarifies: a) absolute cap on any post-commit margin (or a formula), b) definition of permitted pass-throughs, and c) an audit right/notice window?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our legal team needs language by EOD Monday to keep the sprint.

Best,
Elena Soto
Director, Procurement — Acero Health

Attachment: Acero_RFP_excerpt.docx (excerpt, 28KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@acerohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exhibit questions — shelter/margin carve-out

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the RFP excerpt. We're happy to tighten the language. Short answers up front:

- We can propose an absolute cap expressed as +15% of the committed per-unit rate (applies only when utilization falls below the minimum band and after a 30-day notice).
- Partner pass-throughs will be itemized and billed separately unless Acero agrees to include specific named partners in the committed calculation.
- We'll add an audit right with a 45-day remediation window and a single unilateral review per 12-month period.

I'm looping in Karthik (legal) and Laura (billing/operations) to create a redline. Expect draft back today. If you have a preferred cap percentage, let me know — we can be flexible within reason.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-schedule-shelter-draft.pdf (stub, 72KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing exhibit questions — suggested redline

Markus / Laura —

Drafting notes below (will attach redline PDF after internal pass):

- Cap formula: propose language: "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, any ad hoc increase to the per-unit rate resulting from under-utilization shall not exceed fifteen percent (15%) of the Committed Per-Unit Rate for the applicable billing month."
  - Rationale: gives Acero predictability while allowing temporary alignment to short-term cost variance.

- Carve-outs: define "Permitted Pass-Throughs" by narrow list (cloud provider surcharges, third-party model royalties, statutory taxes). All other partner fees must be included in the Committed Usage for floor calculations unless expressly excluded in writing.

- Audit/notice: 45-day notice + 30-day cure; Redwood may perform one audit per 12 months with mutually agreed scope; split cost if material (>5% variance).

- Operationalization: require monthly line-item invoice detail and a billing feed (CSV) to be delivered via the Redwoods billing API. Laura, can ops commit to the billing feed cadence?

I'll produce pricing-exhibit-redline_v2.pdf and send to Elena for review.

—Karthik
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Aug 7, 2026 at 11:03 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Elena —
>
> Thanks for the clear ask and the RFP excerpt. We're happy to tighten the language...

From: Elena Soto <esoto@acerohealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acerohealth.com>, procurement@acerohealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing exhibit questions — shelter/margin carve-out questions

Markus / Karthik,

Thanks — that looks promising. A couple follow-ups from procurement/finance:

- The team prefers a lower cap at +10% if possible. We have internal policy that limits ad hoc supplier rate increases to 10% without executive approval.
- For "Permitted Pass-Throughs": can you add a threshold (e.g., pass-throughs > $5k/month must be pre-notified) and include a sample CSV schema for the billing feed?
- Audit split cost: procurement requests the smaller party pays for the audit unless material >3% variance; they consider 5% too permissive.

If you can accept the +10% cap and tighten the audit threshold to 3%, we can move this through our legal today.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: none

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@acerohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exhibit questions — shelter/margin carve-out questions

Elena —

Appreciate the quick feedback. We can agree to the +10% cap and will tighten audit language to 3% materiality for cost-split. On the threshold for pass-through notices: agree to pre-notify for pass-throughs > $5,000 per month and we'll provide the CSV schema via the Drive link below.

I attached the updated redline (pricing-exhibit-redline_v2.pdf) and the billing CSV template to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/fake-link/pricing-exhibit. If that looks good, I'll request an executed amendment (order form annex) and route it to Acero's signature block.

Next steps I propose:
- Acero legal to confirm language by EOD Wednesday (Aug 12)
- Redwood to issue amendment + DocuSign request once confirmed

Thanks — will standby.

Regards,
Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-exhibit-redline_v2.pdf (redline, 94KB)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/fake-link/pricing-exhibit

From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acerohealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <esoto@acerohealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acerohealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing exhibit questions — shelter/margin carve-out questions

Markus / Elena —

We reviewed the updated redline. Acero legal has confirmed acceptance of the +10% cap, the 3% materiality audit split, and the $5k pass-through notice threshold. Please proceed with the amendment and DocuSign.

One operational ask: can Redwood include a clause in the amendment that commits to daily billing CSV exports for the first 90 days post-amendment (to help our reconciliation)? If so, we can approve routing to signature today.

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
VP, Finance — Acero Health
